note: All ten share one drawing style so they read as a set. Save as JPG at 1200x1200.

images.name: water-damage
images.prompt:
A two-bedroom home plan. A soft blue glow starts at the BATH, flows through the doorway into the LIVING ROOM and curves toward the KITCHEN, with blue arrows following the path.

STYLE — match this exactly across the set:
A clean architectural floor plan drawn from directly overhead, orthographic, no perspective.
White floor, mid-grey walls drawn as solid filled shapes about 8px thick, with doorway gaps and thin door-swing arcs.
Simple line-drawn furniture in light grey outline: beds, sofas, tables, kitchen counters, bathroom fixtures. Outlines only, no fill, no shadows, no textures.
Room names in small grey uppercase sans-serif letters, centred in each room: BEDROOM, BATH, LIVING ROOM, KITCHEN.
The affected path is a soft glowing light-blue wash flowing across the floor, semi-transparent, with a bright blue arrow curving along its direction of travel.
Flat, soft and modern. Pure white background, no border, no frame, no drop shadow, no title block, no scale bar, no dimensions, no north arrow, no watermark.
Square 1:1 composition with even margin on all four sides.

1:1 square, 1200x1200.
